card.name: Words leading into 'range' after 'over'
card.fires_on: Words in the phrase 'over the/a (dose) range of', especially 'over', 'the', 'a' or 'dosage' after 'dose-related' or 'varies'. It also fires on a digit in a dilution table.

modes.label: Over the range
modes.description: The word 'over' or the words right after it, just before the noun 'range' is expected.
modes.example: Blood pressure response is dose related<< over>> the range of 2 to

modes.label: Dose-range numbers
modes.description: Words or units inside a stated dose span just before 'range'.
modes.example: Increases in serum uric acid and decreases in serum potassium are dose-related over the 15 to 100<< mg>>/day range.

card.writes: It boosts the word 'range' as the next word and suppresses unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'over a range of' doses or values.
